newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.98 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.98 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended unchanged at 14.98 ringgit ($5.94) a kg in tandem with the steady overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"The local market was taking its cue from the LME, which was also unchanged," said a trader.

Buyers and seller matched positions for a final turnover of 69 tonnes, against 62 on Tuesday. There was, however, a premium of $15 against the London market owing to a stronger ringgit against the dollar, said traders.
